title: Concept: Rails detailed exception page disclosed in a response
description: The Rails detailed-exception page prints the failing exception, the request parameters, the session identifiers and a window of source code. Serving it discloses the request data of the failing call as well as the application internals, and Rails selects it by default outside production.
applicability: Responses generated by a Rails application running with detailed exceptions enabled.
risk: The caller reads request parameters and session data belonging to the failing request, plus source lines and the exception chain, which is enough to plan a targeted exploit of the endpoint.
